GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, slow into stride and Settled Down last 9 Lengths from the lead, Drifted Back to 10 Lengths turning, Hooked Out 3-4 Wide Straightening Up and Made Ground in straight. (Cheekers FIRST TIME) # slow early

Jumped okay & Settled Down 5.5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to turn then shifted out to 7 Lengths 3 Wide , had cover but Held Up rounding turn, shifted wider Straightening Up and kept making gradual ground in Straight # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Awkwardly placed at heels and held up for clear running round home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Drifted Back Settled Down 5th Inside 4-5 Lengths Hard Ridden x 400m, clear run home Outside 3rd x 100m Kept Coming Closest on line, # Sound eff/finale
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained thus Settled Down 2nd last 8 Lengths went Five Wide x 400m Just Kept Going One Pace - # No Run On
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When placed under pressure, was inclined to lay in, proving difficult to ride out. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained from Outside Settled Down 10th 11 Lengths let stride @ 600m, 9th x 400m 7 Lengths clear run home to the 200m then eased off heels Restricted Room Kept Coming Sound - # no run vital stage
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 150m was obliged to alter course in order to improve.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, Restrained & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths on fence, held together much same to turn 2.5 Lengths Two Wide , Held Up 300m--200m then shifted 3-4 Wide and ran on, loomed up at the 150m and battled head'n'head to the line # missed/headbobber
Jumped okay & Settled Down 4.5 Lengths 3 Wide , Drifted Back to 6 Lengths 3 Wide turning, kept coming in Straight # wide, kept coming
Jumped Ok Straight Out The Back Settled Down 2nd last 8 Lengths off leader/winner within 5 Lengths x 500m clear run home ran on to the line - # Sound eff/finale
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in on jumping and bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 6.5 Lengths Two Wide , little change to Turn then shifted out to 6 Lengths 3 Wide , Made Good Ground 3-and-4 Wide sown the Straight # Did Best Work Late
Jumped Ok Drifted Back Settled Down 8th Inside 5 Lengths held-up x 600 4 Lengths trav well Straightening Up but was locked away nowhere to go until the very late - # cert beat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up round home turn until the 250m. Inconvenienced near 150m and then held up for the remainder of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained from Outside thus Settled Down 6th Outside 8 Lengths off leader/winner too much to do Clear All The Way , finally asked to go at the 400m, kept trying without threatening Inconclusive - # sat too far back
